text:
incident-bot: SEV2 incident 1934559900 resolved. Root cause: scheduler backpressure during staged rollout. Customer impact: ~12% request errors for ~11m (some Dedicated tenants). I'm creating this thread for handoff, quick recon, and follow-ups. On-call: olivia.chen — please confirm whether you want a fast 20m recon or schedule the full postmortem.

olivia.chen: oncall here. I ran the initial triage at 01:10, escalated to infra, we scaled the scheduler pool and rolled back the rollout at 01:23. Error rates returned to baseline by 01:31. I'll do a 20m recon in 10 min. Need a short template so we can capture timeline + customer impact quickly.

samir: +1 for a tiny immediate recon. Long-term: propose we auto-generate the post-incident doc + calendar invite when incident severity >= S2. Minimal command prototype: 
```
/postmortem create --incident 1934559900 --lead @olivia.chen --severity S2 --impact "12% errors, 11m" --tags scheduler, rollout
```
That should create a stub in infra/postmortems and create a calendar held for 60m with the lead as organizer.

tia: love it. We should also auto-provision action items into the action-tracker so nothing slips. Proposed action payload fields: owner, description, due_delta (e.g. 7d), priority, customer_impact. Example command: 
```
/postmortem actions add --incident 1934559900 --owner @maria --desc "Add scheduler retry logic" --due 7d --priority P2 --customer-impact high
```
This creates a card in the action-tracker UI and links back to the postmortem doc.

nate: couple quick Qs: can we auto-link PagerDuty/opsgenie incidents so the postmortem doc has the original paging timeline? Also can the handoff include a small checksum: who paged, who acknowledged, and whether runbook steps were followed. I worry about duplicate paging during noisy incidents.

maria: I'll take the dashboard integration. I can add a column for "handoff-complete" and "customer-contacted". Also we should have small TTL tags so actions auto-escalate if not updated. I'll build a proof-of-concept connector that listens for the `/postmortem` events and creates cards.

olivia.chen: for the immediate recon, let's do 20m starting in 8. Focus: timeline + what changed in rollout config, what telemetry missed the signal, and list of affected tenants for follow-up. Can someone run quick query for erroring tenant ids?

samir: grabbing tenant list now, will paste in a sec. Quick snippet I'm running: 
```bash
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/errors?since=01:10&until=01:32&group_by=tenant" | jq -r '.items[] | select(.rate>0.05) | {tenant: .tenant, rate: .rate}'
```

deploy-bot: rollback of rollout rollout-2026-03-15-14 completed by @infra-ci at 01:23 UTC.

incident-bot: created postmortem stub: infra/postmortems/1934559900-scheduler-backpressure and scheduled calendar event "SEV2 recon — 1934559900" for 60m starting 01:40 UTC (organizer @olivia.chen). Created action-tracker card for immediate remediation: "increase scheduler consumer buffer" assigned to @samir, due 3d.

maria: added dashboard card and linked postmortem stub. I also added a ticket to vendor-tracker for the scheduler library with the initial regressed kernel.

nate: for duplicate pings: propose small bot check before page: if incident has active handoff tag within last 10m, suppress duplicate page and DM on-call instead. Example proto: 
```
/handoff-check 1934559900 --suppress-window 10m
```

tia: decision items: 1) implement `/postmortem create` prototype (samir + olivia) 2) action-tracker integration (tia + maria) 3) handoff-check suppression logic (nate) 4) dashboard card + TTL (maria). Who wants to pick up docs and template?

olivia.chen: I'll draft the quick template: timeline, customer-impact, immediate-mitigation, root-cause hypothesis, action-items table with owners + due dates + status. I'll push to infra/postmortems/1934559900-draft and tag you all.

samir: I'll wire the calendar + repo stub creation. Will open PR with the slash-command handler + tests.

maria: will wire the dashboard connector and TTL escalation rule.

nate: I'll prototype the handoff-check suppression in the pager adapter.

incident-bot: summarizing decisions and assigned owners: 
- postmortem stub + template: @olivia.chen (PR due in 48h) 
- calendar/autogen: @samir (PR + integration tests in 72h) 
- action-tracker connector: @tia & @maria (POC in 5d) 
- handoff suppress: @nate (prototype in 3d) 
- dashboard card + TTL escalation: @maria (POC in 5d)

olivia.chen: noted. I'll update the thread when draft is pushed. Thanks team — recon started now. :thumbsup:
